title: POST /rest/saiku/session/clear is no longer an anonymous, unthrottled password oracle and second login path

criteria.given: an anonymous caller posting credentials to /rest/saiku/session/clear
criteria.then: the request is refused (403 CSRF required, or 404/405 once the route is gone); it never reaches a credential check and never answers 200 or 500

steps.name: the legacy /session/clear route no longer reaches a credential check
